name: hansgrohe
verdict: Hansgrohe SE is majority-owned (68%) by the US-listed Masco Corporation; the Grohe family holds 32%. Nothing found.
note: German sanitary-fittings manufacturer. Rating note (issue #603, 2026-09-29): Masco is a NYSE-listed building-products group with no controlling shareholder; no state anywhere in the chain, and no human-rights finding against Hansgrohe or Masco found.
